info.title: Taptime integration API -- sandbox additions
info.description:
What the Taptime SANDBOX adds to the integration API, and nothing else. Every other path, header, limit and rule is the integration API's own: GET /v1/openapi.yaml on the same host (the shipped document), and the integration guide's section 1.4. The sandbox runs its own build of Taptime on its own domain with its own database: no production business, key or punch is in it, and a production key is refused there (401) as a sandbox key is refused in production.

Keys: a sandbox key starts with `tt_test_` and is issued by the business's owner in the sandbox's Taptime panel. The API of a sandbox business is enabled by the sandbox's Taptime operator, exactly as in production: until then a valid key is 403 `api_disabled`.

The simulation: a sandbox has no wall and no phone, so `POST /v1/sandbox/taps` stands in for the plaque's touch and the employee's phone. From the plaque on, the tap is Taptime's own: the plaque's signed URL is checked, its counter is advanced atomically, the decision rules decide, the record is written, and a punch it makes is in the feed and is sent to the webhook like any other.

sandboxHost.description: The sandbox's API host. Its domain is not chosen yet.

get.description: Served without a key, metered by the client address, like /v1/openapi.yaml. It takes no query parameter.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of the sandbox's additions.

post.summary: Simulate an employee's touch of a location's plaque.
post.description:
The employee (`employeeRef`, of the key's business) touches the plaque of the location (`locationRef`): the key's business's own location, or -- the group touch -- a location of another company of its group. `channel` is `nfc` (the plaque's signed read) or `qr` (the printed code, which carries no proof of the moment and is approved only on an address match).

The plaque is the location's virtual plaque. A location of the key's own business gets one on its first simulated tap; a partner company's location has one once that company has simulated a tap there itself -- the sandbox never provisions a plaque in another business (the group touch itself is recorded as a real one is: it advances the partner's plaque counter and appears in the partner's location feed).

Where: the request's own address is the tap's address. A location created through the API has no address ranges or coordinate until its owner sets them in the panel, so its taps are recorded as `flag` and wait for approval; set the venue's address range to your caller's address to see `ok`. There is no GPS. Who: the employee is taken as tapping from their own phone -- whether they activated is not asked.

Every simulated tap is recorded, with the verdict the rules give it: `ok`, `flag`, `reject` (a lost or retired plaque, a deactivated employee, a replayed counter) or `ignored` (the same person again within 60 seconds). An `ok` tap is a punch at once (`inFeed`); a flagged one becomes a punch, under the same `punchId`, when the employer approves it.

Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and the same body returns the first tap's answer. While the business is suspended this endpoint is 403 `tenant_suspended`.

groupTouch.summary: A KM employee touches KF's plaque at Valletta.

bearer.description: A sandbox integration key, `tt_test_` followed by 43 base64url characters.

Problem.description: A refusal, in the shipped document's `Error` shape.

employeeRef.description: The employee's external reference, in the key's business.

locationRef.description: The location's external reference: the key's business's, else one company's of its group.

punchId.description: `pch_` and a UUID: the id the feed and the webhook carry for this tap when it is a punch.

inFeed.description: Whether the tap is a punch now (an `ok` tap).

trust.description: 20 + 50 (address matched) + 30 (GPS matched). Null for a touch at a partner company's location: it was judged on that company's evidence, which is not shown.

rule.description: The decision rule that decided, e.g. `base:no-evidence-review`. Null for a touch at a partner company's location.

ErrorDetails.description: The shipped document's ErrorDetails, with the simulation's own values below; every key is optional.
